title: P112: exclude every rational choice in the fixed six-query P8 family
body:
For the fixed P112 target pairs `{0,67}`, `{7,64}`, `{1,75}`, the prescribed six-query P8 extension has exact minimum full-group invoice **18 for every rational vector h on all112 ports**, with arbitrary copy-asymmetric rational readers and the exact three-projector endpoint. The two cases rank[c0,c1,c2,h]=3 or4 are both closed. Thus this entire fixed family cannot improve its canonical baseline18.

The rank-four proof reduces all exterior choices to324 source patterns and exhaustively prices10,497,600 reader cells. The new rank-three proof expands all84 maximal minors of `[I3|A0+h*b^t]`; they yield25 affine hyperplanes and443 complete algebraic strata. These determine source supports and every actual three-coordinate reader recovery. Independent threshold methods cover the resulting2,785,849,439 support cells and exclude costs≤17. This is a complete rational-family classification, not a coefficient box. An exact h=0 witness attains18; the threshold calculation does not assert that every stratum attains18.

Four standalone standard-library commands regenerate source classifications, all4096 physical tariffs, actual readers and exact112×112 attaining endpoints. The rank-three checkers use different flat enumerations and pricing algorithms (branch-and-bound versus meet-in-the-middle), agree on the complete support-profile digest, and independently check the123990 surviving invoice cells. Registered replay, metadata and committed-byte/source-history checks pass at `5f87491f9e9dfbc3c0c8d1fa37b767c790153c73`. All four commands also pass from the official Git-free export with empty PATH and read-only files; all19 file hashes remain unchanged (13.58seconds, Python3.12.14, Windows). Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-p8-exterior-family`.

The statement fixes the dictionary, marking, physical embedding and exact endpoint. Other dictionaries/placements, changed allowed-free fitting entries, unrestricted decoders and native supplier obligations remain open. This supplies no improved full decoder or multiplication bound. The classical P8 representation is credited to Choe, Oxley, Sokal and Wagner, *Homogeneous Multivariate Polynomials with the Half-Plane Property*, Example11.8/AppendixA.4; the additional query `c0+h` is explicit. The predecessor P112 cover/pricing lineage retains its attribution.

Canonical main was refreshed before publication and remains `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244` (priority7). The assigned decoder goal is recorded as a scope change. A current open-PR delta supplements the earlier complete snapshot; Discussion coverage remains unavailable after persistentHTTP406, so no exhaustive novelty claim is made. Prepared by flyingviper with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI-agent mathematical/implementation reviews. No independent human or proof-assistant verification is claimed.
